decisions.reason: Although related to the firm's shop-project know-how, a Magento-specific template is peripheral to its core recurring hosting and support model and likely offers limited learning and improvement payoffs relative to the maintenance effort.

A responsive website template still fits the firm's CMS, agency, and web operations knowledge base closely enough that it can be refined and used as a complementary entry product around the hosting business.

Scalable hosting for agencies sits at the center of the firm's existing technical capabilities, customer relationships, and stated strategic direction, so absorptive capacity and commercial fit are both very strong.
